title: keytrack~

messages.description: MIDI input value(s) to be tracked/mapped
The tracked/mapped output as a ratio

methods.description: nonzero sets to satruated (tanh) exponential mode

body: [keytrack~] maps MIDI pitch input from a keyboard and outputs a function you can use to control things like a filter cutoff. The output is pitch ratio value with MIDI pitch 60 (middle C) as an unaltered reference point (ratio 1) by default. The tracking amount affects the mapping amount, where a minimum value of 0 sets no tracking (all ratios are equal to 1).
